blocks.prompt: 6 Given the function \(f(x) = \ln x\), find the equation of the transformed function obtained after shifting the graph 1 unit to the right, vertically compressing it by a factor of 2, and then shifting it 3 units upward.
blocks.explanation:
Yahan teen transformations di gayi tarteeb mein lagani hain.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \ln x\).
Find kya karna hai? Teeno tabdeeliyon ke baad aakhri function.
Rule: 1 daayen = \(x\) ki jagah \(x - 1\); 2 se vertical compression = poore ko \(\frac{1}{2}\) se zarb; 3 oopar = 3 jama.
Plan: ek ek qadam, har dafa naye function par.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \ln x\), \(x > 0\).
Maloom karna: teen transformations ke baad function.
Tareeqa: \(y = f(x - h)\), \(h = 1\); \(y = af(x)\), \(a = \frac{1}{2}\) (kyun ke compression ka factor \(\frac{1}{a} = 2\) hai); \(y = f(x) + k\), \(k = 3\).

Qadam 1: 1 unit daayen
\[g_{1}(x) = \ln(x - 1)\]
Kyun: daayen \(h = 1\) se \(x\) ki jagah \(x - 1\) aata hai (andar ki tabdeeli ulti chalti hai).

Qadam 2: 2 se vertical compression
\[g_{2}(x) = \tfrac{1}{2}\ln(x - 1)\]
Kyun: factor 2 se vertical compression ka matlab \(a = \frac{1}{2}\); har output aadha ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: \(2\ln(x - 1)\) ghalat hai; woh to stretch hota. Compression mein graph chapta hota hai, is liye aadha.

Qadam 3: 3 units oopar
\[y = \tfrac{1}{2}\ln(x - 1) + 3\]
\[= \ln\sqrt{x - 1} + 3\]
Kyun: oopar 3 ke liye 3 jama kiya. Aur log ka power law: \(\frac{1}{2}\ln u = \ln u^{1/2} = \ln\sqrt{u}\). Kitab ka jawab isi doosri shakal mein hai; dono ek hi function hain.

Tasdeeq:
\(\ln x\) ka point \((1, 0)\) follow karein: 1 daayen \(\to (2, 0)\); compression mein \(y = 0\) wala point nahin hilta, \((2, 0)\); 3 oopar \(\to (2, 3)\).
\[\tfrac{1}{2}\ln(2 - 1) + 3 = 0 + 3 = 3\]
Asymptote \(x = 0\) bhi 1 daayen ho kar \(x = 1\) ban gaya, is liye domain \(x > 1\) hai.
